evidence.quoted_text: const known = observation?.usage !== undefined && usage !== undefined;
evidence.reason: Line 664 treats any defined aggregate `report.usage` as a known measurement. The finding's described `address` accounting can include unmeasured dispatches as zero in that aggregate while recording them as unknown observations in `report.usageSummary`; the visible settlement logic never consults that summary, so the leg takes the known path and releases its reservation despite unknown provider spend. That can admit later PRs beyond the requested token budget. The existing unknown-usage settlement path is the appropriate fallback.
